supplemental_items.interpretation: Anchor eligibility requires Break, anchor, immediate adjacency and nonempty direction Reset list; use last recorded Reset index, opposite detector from that index to First. Any opposite Break equal anchor establishes confirmation; not a time-sorted re-selection.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of assignment, mutation, provenance, guard order, aliasing or native tie key beyond category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Confirmed anchor can replace confirmation-side price/source on exact inequality (bearish anchor High<=First High, otherwise anchor Low>=First Low). No separate price comparison against existing box edge; do not invent shrink guard from comment.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of assignment, mutation, provenance, guard order, aliasing or native tie key beyond category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Nonnull Break recomputes outward edge inclusive First..Break. Only Break-owned extreme and nonnull exact analysis replace price/source, including confirming lower row under RE10/25. No hit retains full main geometry. Null Break skips recompute but still appends shallow copy and returns true; caller owns confirmation validity.

supplemental_items.interpretation: Nonbullish selects bearish analysis; only exact bearish mutates top and exact bullish mutates bottom, separate guards. Null returns before any mutation. Nonnull analysis returned even if no ownership match.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of assignment, mutation, provenance, guard order, aliasing or native tie key beyond category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Correct First tag and nonnull analysis required; search strictly later datetime (+1us) to exclusive main end against analysis.extreme, not confirmed argument (unused). Any nonnull outward hit rejects. Otherwise read whole Break interval, reject empty.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first review of assignment, mutation, provenance, guard order, aliasing or native tie key beyond category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Top uses max(High,-timestamp.timestamp()) where epoch float conversion is native, not exact Decimal price conversion; bottom uses min(Low,datetime). Bull top then bottom, nonbull bottom then top; equal full keys retain first encountered row. Candidate provenance both edges current main, full lower prices, intrabar start main open, mode B; no claim of arbitrary timezone-independent earliest timestamp.

findings.description: Prior pre-confirmation wording omitted inclusive confirming row and null-Break append behavior.
findings.resolution: if Break owns extreme and exact analysis available refine through the confirming lower row inclusive, otherwise keep full-main extreme. A null Break skips canonical recomputation but does not prevent append. Append replace(candidate) to direction list, return true. Mutates supplied candidate before copy; caller owns confirmation validity.

findings.description: Distinguish dispatch else from exact bearish mutation guard; preserve analysis return without refinement.
findings.resolution: Directional analysis RE10/25 (exact bullish selects breakout, otherwise breakdown). Null =>null. Separate exact bullish/bearish guards refine the corresponding opposite edge only if its source equals current candle.index; nonbullish/nonbearish input can dispatch breakdown without mutating either edge. Return nonnull analysis even if no refinement.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic recheck remain pending.

findings.description: Specify native timestamp tie keys and directional evaluation order without overclaiming exact timestamp ordering.
findings.resolution: Choose max key (High, negative native timestamp.timestamp() epoch float) and min key (Low, datetime); equal full keys retain first encountered row. Bullish evaluates top then bottom, otherwise bottom then top. Native epoch conversion and precision govern top tie behavior, not an additional exact datetime comparison.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic recheck remain pending.

findings.description: Align state transition with native top/bottom tie keys rather than generic earliest-edge assertion.
